messages:
noah (Billing Ops): Citrine Dynamics invoice INV-2026-1022 (USD 6,400) is 21 days overdue. ACH returned R02 two attempts. Customer emailed saying treasury is reconciling vendor IDs after ERP cutover and asked for a temporary hold while they confirm new payment details. Proposing a short 'payment bridge' — 25% now, 50% in 30d, remainder in 60d. Also request PO reference and updated remit. Thoughts?
teresa (FinOps): Do we have authority to pause dunning for ACH returns and require PO before resuming? Need to know if we can waive the standard suspension. Also what's our maximum concession without C-level sign-off?
sam (Collections): For enterprise customers with valid contract, we can do a 90-day staged plan w/ exec approval for >$5k split. Options: A) immediate 25% via virtual card + staged ACH, or B) hold with escrow memo and require signed payment plan + PO. We need an approved sign-off because total >$5k.
lina (Billing Manager): I can approve up to $500 concession or fee waiver. Anything that changes payment terms materially (beyond 30 days) needs Finance + Revenue Ops sign-off. If customer supplies PO and signs agreement, we can record a revenue deferral schedule.
noah (Billing Ops): Customer specifically asked no service interruption. They offered to push 40% via wire today if we can accept. They want waiver of late fees and no collection mark on their vendor report.
teresa (FinOps): Wire today is best — avoids ACH rejections. Accept wire + record staged remaining on ledger. For waiver: recommend we allow full late-fee waiver as a one-time commercial gesture, but record concession in AR notes and tag GL 4305. Need Revenue Ops + FP&A notified.
sam (Collections): I'll draft the payment plan and get Legal to add a clause: if wire fails or subsequent ACH returns, the hold is revoked and service may be suspended. Also require signed PO and email from treasury confirming wiring instructions.
payments-bot: System: invoice INV-2026-1022 status set to "on_hold_pending_payment" by noah (Billing Ops) at 2161234700.
lina (Billing Manager): Approve one-time waiver of late fees up to $320 contingent on receiving the wire (>=40% today) and signed payment plan. Finance will need a GL memo for the waiver.
noah (Billing Ops): I'll send wire details and the plan to the customer now. Sam — can you own the payment plan doc? I'll ask Legal to expedite.
sam (Collections): On it. Will attach template in 30m and loop Legal. I'll also set follow-up reminders in 72h.
teresa (FinOps): Once wire clears, post to AR and update revenue deferral schedule. I'll notify FP&A about the concession so it's captured in the weekly AR notes.
noah (Billing Ops): Customer replied: treasury will attempt wire by EOD and will send back the PO. Marking follow-up 24h. Thanks everyone. :pray:
